tools.name: currencylayer_convert_currency
tools.description: SPENDS 1 request of your currencylayer monthly quota per call (also when it fails after authentication; it is never retried). Convert an amount from one currency to another with real-time rates, or with the rates of a past date. Returns the result and the quote used. Needs the Basic plan or higher.
